skill.summary: Tracks OpenClaw API usage and spending in real-time with customizable budget alerts and detailed cost breakdowns by model and session.

latestVersion.changelog:
ClawMeter 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches a comprehensive dashboard to track OpenClaw API usage and costs in real-time.
- Supports detailed analytics (daily/weekly/monthly spend, top sessions, model cost breakdowns).
- Provides API endpoints for summary stats, cost breakdowns, and alerts.
- Enables customizable daily and monthly budget alerts via email or Telegram.
- Includes user-friendly setup, example agent integrations, and troubleshooting guide.
